info.title: game/v1/engine.proto
info.description:
Package game.v1 is the Core service boundary — the central product surface.
Core serves this contract over both gRPC and REST: the google.api.http
annotations below drive a grpc-gateway that exposes every RPC as JSON/HTTP
under /api/v1, wrapped in the uniform {code, message, trace_id, data}
envelope. Core is auth-agnostic — it trusts the caller (a BFF the developer
builds, see examples/) to authenticate and to pass the tenant/merchant Scope;
it only validates and operates on the business object. Errors map to gRPC
status codes (and to the envelope at the gateway). Versioned by package; a
breaking change becomes game.v2.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
ResolveOrCreate takes a VERIFIED contact and returns the identity (created if
new). The hosting auth layer calls this after a provider verifies the contact.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
ResolvePlayer is the business operation behind login: given a VERIFIED contact
(the caller — a BFF — has already authenticated it), resolve-or-create the
global identity and upsert the tenant-scoped player. Authentication itself
(challenge issue/verify, token minting) is NOT Core's concern; it lives in the
BFF, which calls this after a successful verification.

settings.title: raw JSON: {require_auth, auth_methods, collect_fields, max_plays_per_user, max_plays_per_day, wallet_scope}

campaign.description:
Campaign groups games + quests under a merchant, with channels, auth methods,
a run window, and widget/eligibility settings. tenant_id + merchant_id are the
isolation boundary (from the scope, never the path).

FulfillmentServiceReportResultBody.description:
ReportResult finalizes a task from an external orchestrator (n8n) callback.
Looked up by the globally-unique task_id; scope is advisory.

leaderboard.description:
Leaderboard config. time_window/prize_tiers/anti_cheat are raw JSON (decoded
by the hosting layer): time_window={type,period,start,end},
prize_tiers=[{from_rank,to_rank,prize_id}], anti_cheat={score_ceiling,flag_outliers}.

QuestServiceCompleteQuestBody.description: CompleteQuest verifies the proof, gates re-completion, and grants the reward.

quest.description:
Quest is an admin-configured mission under a campaign. config is verifier-
specific raw JSON (decoded only by the matching quest-type verifier).

prize.description: Prize is an awardable item with finite stock.

protobufNullValue.description:
`NullValue` is a singleton enumeration to represent the null value for the
`Value` type union.

The JSON representation for `NullValue` is JSON `null`.

 - NULL_VALUE: Null value.

v1AuthMethod.description: AuthMethod is the verification method used to start/complete a login.

settings.title: raw JSON: {require_auth, auth_methods, collect_fields, max_plays_per_user, max_plays_per_day, wallet_scope}

v1Campaign.description:
Campaign groups games + quests under a merchant, with channels, auth methods,
a run window, and widget/eligibility settings. tenant_id + merchant_id are the
isolation boundary (from the scope, never the path).

v1CampaignStatus.description: CampaignStatus is a campaign's lifecycle state.

v1Contact.description: Contact is a verified means of identifying a person (globally unique).

v1ContactType.description: ContactType is the kind of a verified contact.

game_id.title: associates the prize with a game for stock listing

v1EntryState.description: EntryState is a ranked entry's standing.

receipt.description: raw JSON: voucher code, tracking no., ...

v1FulfillmentTask.description:
FulfillmentTask is one row of the transactional outbox: a unit of delivery
work committed atomically with the reward it delivers.

handler_config.title: raw JSON, decoded by the reward handler/seed

validator_config.title: raw JSON, decoded by the validator (anti-cheat)

milestones.title: raw JSON: milestone config (currency, mode, auto_grant, thresholds)

v1Game.description:
Game is the config-driven game definition. handler_config is opaque JSON the
engine never interprets (decoded only by the reward handler/seed). Widget/UI
render config is NOT a Core concern — it lives in the presentation layer (BFF).

v1GameStatus.description: GameStatus is a game's lifecycle state.

v1IntegrationStatus.description: IntegrationStatus is whether an integration is firing.

v1IntegrationType.description: IntegrationType is the outbound adapter kind.

v1Leaderboard.description:
Leaderboard config. time_window/prize_tiers/anti_cheat are raw JSON (decoded
by the hosting layer): time_window={type,period,start,end},
prize_tiers=[{from_rank,to_rank,prize_id}], anti_cheat={score_ceiling,flag_outliers}.

v1LeaderboardMetric.description: LeaderboardMetric is the score a leaderboard ranks by.

v1LeaderboardStatus.description: LeaderboardStatus is a leaderboard's lifecycle state.

v1LedgerReason.description: LedgerReason is why a wallet ledger entry was written.

v1MilestoneMode.description: MilestoneMode is how a milestone set behaves.

v1MilestoneStatus.description: MilestoneStatus is a milestone's progress state for a player.

v1Prize.description: Prize is an awardable item with finite stock.

v1Quest.description:
Quest is an admin-configured mission under a campaign. config is verifier-
specific raw JSON (decoded only by the matching quest-type verifier).

v1QuestRewardType.description: QuestRewardType is the kind of reward a quest grants on completion.

v1QuestState.description: QuestState is a quest plus the caller's completion status (player list).

v1QuestStatus.description: QuestStatus is whether a quest is live.

v1RankedEntry.description: RankedEntry is one player's standing (player list / rankings).

v1ResolveOrCreateRequest.description:
ResolveOrCreate takes a VERIFIED contact and returns the identity (created if
new). The hosting auth layer calls this after a provider verifies the contact.

v1ResolvePlayerRequest.description:
ResolvePlayer is the business operation behind login: given a VERIFIED contact
(the caller — a BFF — has already authenticated it), resolve-or-create the
global identity and upsert the tenant-scoped player. Authentication itself
(challenge issue/verify, token minting) is NOT Core's concern; it lives in the
BFF, which calls this after a successful verification.

v1Reward.description: Reward is a single awarded item in a play result.

v1RewardRecord.description: RewardRecord is a durable record that a player won one unit of a prize.

v1RewardStatus.description: RewardStatus is the lifecycle of an awarded reward record.

use_turns.title: gate on quest-granted turn balance (keyed by campaign)

v1Scope.description: Scope is the tenant/merchant isolation boundary on every request.

v1TaskStatus.description:
TaskStatus is the state of a fulfillment outbox task. ReportResult callbacks
finalize a task to FULFILLED or FAILED.

v1WalletScope.description:
WalletScope is the isolation level points/milestones are keyed by
(UNSPECIFIED → campaign, the default).
